prompt: The legacy FocusZone exported from @fluentui-react-native/native-core/legacy does not restore focus to its default tabbable element on macOS. Plan the fix.

assertions.description: Treats the legacy entrypoint as a framework-base wrapper over native code rather than v0 or v1 maintenance.
Keeps the legacy public API, componentRef behavior, and native registration unchanged.
Plans macOS Fabric and Paper evidence, using the --paper Storybook flag for Paper, and confirms actual native focus rather than a request result.
